SSTV demodulation and sync detection adapted from smolgroot/sstv-decoder, based on xdsopl/robot36.
https://github.com/smolgroot/sstv-decoder

Changes: TypeScript converted to JavaScript; debug console output removed; extended sync window for contiguous Robot36 VIS stop/first-line sync. Image assembly and encoder are separate implementations.
